shortDescription: Create or delete AWS Autoscaling Launch Configurations

options.name: access_key
options.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) or C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(aws_access_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_access_key_id) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: assign_public_ip
options.description: Used for Auto Scaling groups that launch instances into an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud. Specifies whether to assign a public IP address to each instance launched in a Amazon VPC.

options.name: aws_ca_bundle
options.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The C(AWS_CA_BUNDLE) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: aws_config
options.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation U(https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config).

options.name: classic_link_vpc_id
options.description: Id of ClassicLink enabled VPC

options.name: classic_link_vpc_security_groups
options.description: A list of security group IDs with which to associate the ClassicLink VPC instances.

options.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
options.description: Use a C(botocore.endpoint) logger to parse the unique (rather than total) C("resource:action") API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the C(aws_resource_action) callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The C(ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: ebs_optimized
options.description: Specifies whether the instance is optimized for EBS I/O (true) or not (false).

options.name: endpoint_url
options.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints.  While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The  C(AWS_URL) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: image_id
options.description: The AMI unique identifier to be used for the group.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The Id of a running instance to use as a basis for a launch configuration. Can be used in place of I(image_id) and I(instance_type).

options.name: instance_monitoring
options.description: Specifies whether instances are launched with detailed monitoring.

options.name: instance_profile_name
options.description: The name or the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the instance profile associated with the IAM role for the instances.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: Instance type to use for the instance. Required when creating a new Launch Configuration.

options.name: kernel_id
options.description: Kernel id for the EC2 instance.

options.name: key_name
options.description: The SSH key name to be used for access to managed instances.

options.name: name
options.description: Unique name for configuration.

options.name: placement_tenancy
options.description: Determines whether the instance runs on single-tenant hardware or not. When not set AWS will default to C(default).

options.name: profile
options.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html). The C(AWS_PROFILE) environment variable may also be used. The I(profile) option is mutually exclusive with the I(aws_access_key), I(aws_secret_key) and I(session_token) options.

options.name: ramdisk_id
options.description: A RAM disk id for the instances.

options.name: region
options.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, I(region) is ignored. The C(AWS_REGION) environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information U(http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region).

options.name: secret_key
options.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) or C(AWS_SECRET_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(secret_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_secret_access_key) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: A list of security groups to apply to the instances. You can specify either security group names or IDs or a mix.

options.name: session_token
options.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) environment variable may also be used. The I(session_token) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: spot_price
options.description: The spot price you are bidding. Only applies for an autoscaling group with spot instances.

options.name: state
options.description: Register or deregister the instance.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Opaque blob of data which is made available to the ec2 instance. Mutually exclusive with I(user_data_path).

options.name: user_data_path
options.description: Path to the file that contains userdata for the ec2 instances. Mutually exclusive with I(user_data).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: When set to C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting I(validate_certs=false) is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting I(aws_ca_bundle) instead.

options.name: volumes
options.description: A list dictionaries defining the volumes to create. For any volume, a volume size less than C(1) will be interpreted as a request not to create the volume.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: VPC ID, used when resolving security group names to IDs.
